metadata.caribbean_note: Wind turbines are used across Caribbean islands as renewable energy sources

question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q2c — Wind Turbine Efficiency
question.text:
A wind turbine is used in some Caribbean countries as an alternative energy source. The mass of air passing through the circular area swept by the turbine blades every second is 8.5 kg, and its kinetic energy during this time is 2 500 J.

The output power of the generator is 1 350 W.
question.general_feedback:
Model solution:
(i) KE = ½mv² → v = √(2KE/m) = √(2 × 2500 / 8.5) = √(588.24) = 24.2 m s⁻¹ (accept 24–25)
(ii) P_input = KE per second = 2500 J / 1 s = 2 500 W
(iii) Efficiency = (P_output / P_input) × 100 = (1350 / 2500) × 100 = 54%

steps.label:
Given: Mass of air per second m = 8.5 kg  |  KE per second = 2 500 J  |  Poutput = 1 350 W
Formulas: KE = ½mv²    Efficiency = (Pout / Pin) × 100%
Calculate the speed of the air passing through the turbine blades. (3 marks)
Calculate the input power of the air. (2 marks)
Calculate the efficiency of the wind turbine. (3 marks)

fields.label: Rearrange KE = ½mv² to find v²:   v² = _____
Speed of air v = _____ m s⁻¹

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: v = √(v²) = √(588.24) ≈ 24.2 m s⁻¹. Remember to take the square root.

fields.label: Input power P<sub>input</sub> = _____ W
fields.diagnostic_hint: Input power = KE transferred per second = 2500 J/s = 2500 W

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Power = energy per unit time. The KE given (2500 J) is already per second, so P_input = 2500 W.

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Efficiency = useful output power / total input power. Do not use P_in / P_out.
